meta.title: Genomic epidemiology of novel coronavirus - Co_Dz_Everything-focused subsampling
meta.description: This phylogeny shows SARS-CoV-2 sequences recovered from animals at the Denver Zoo from October-December 2021 in addition to a subsample of human-derived sequences (100 sequences/day) from the two weeks leading up to the outbreak in the state of Colorado. In addition, this phylogeny includes all sequences from humans in CO from two weeks before the outbreak to one week after the last animal tested positive that were classified as AY.20 lineage (~200 sequences).
